object.attr: derived: a merge resolved in a git client, or a hand edit, can lower the next object number, so a new object takes an ID used before (CF-C20, review Q9). A manifest without the attribute isn't checked, so older documents still pass, as MELLON-STORE-SRS-1 intends.
object.description: If a manifest holds a next-object-number attribute whose value isn't greater than the object number of each object in the document, Mellon shall report the validation error DOC_NEXT_NUMBER_LOW.
